Prokinetics
Help strengthen the pyloric sphincter and increase speed 
of gastric emptying. This group includes bethanechol 
(Urecholine) and metoclopramide (Reglan).
These drugs may have frequent side effects that can
limit their usefulness in treatment of GERD.
